name: kms
description: Vivantel KMS (Knowledge Management System): give your AI coding agent durable, checkable knowledge — decisions, facts, and guardrails it won't forget, contradict, or re-litigate. Everyday development skills for Claude Code. Get started fast with quickstart; bootstrap a project's fact/decision/guardrail system, capture each session's decisions into it, record one with decide, lint it for structural rot, query it for answers with citations, and onboard a role from it; check a pending change conforms before it lands, attribute commits and PRs to their underlying intent, and uninstall cleanly when you're done.
